name: Carbon capture on LNG plants (acid gas reinjection)
principle: CO2 removed from the feed gas at an LNG plant is compressed and injected into deep reservoirs instead of being vented. Gorgon LNG on Barrow Island, Western Australia, is the largest example: Chevron started the injection system in August 2019 with a design of 3.4 to 4 Mtpa.

process_steps.name: Acid gas removal from feed gas

performance.basis: capture and injection; about 100 Mt over the 40-year project life

source.note: Oil & Gas Journal, Chevron Australia starts up Gorgon LNG carbon-capture project, 8 August 2019

performance.metric: Gorgon emissions cut when fully operational
performance.basis: Chevron claim for total greenhouse gas emissions
